newsitem.headline: EP RULES OF PROCEDURE COMMITTEE AGENDA - FEB 3-4.

text.p: Committee on the Rules of Procedure, the Verification of Credentials and Immunities [[ Monday 03 February 1997 ]] 0.1 1. Adoption of draft agenda (PE221.098 ) 2. Approval of minutes of meeting of: - 16 and 17 December 1996 (PE220.617 ) ===] Consideration in camera 3. Ineligibility and termination of mandate as a Member of the European Parliament - Continuation of the procedure decided at the meeting of 22 and 23 January 1997 3.1 * * ===] Interpretation 4. Rule 92(2) - tabling of oral amendments to recommendations not available in all languages (T04875) REG0071 + REGL Fond DONNELLY Brendan P. (PPE) (PE220.616 ) - Consideration of draft report ===] Amendment 5. The conduct of debates in plenary sitting (T04622) INI0478 INI0478 + REGL Fond WIJSENBEEK Florus A. (ELD) (PE220.618 ) - Exchange of views Exchange of views with Mr Romer, Director-General for the Presidency 6. Financing and operation of the intergroups (T04836) REG0068 + REGL Fond R SPIERS Shaun M. (PSE) - Decision on holding hearing 7. Rule 48: Written declarations (T05319) REG0103 REG0103 B4-1092/96 B4-1092/96 + REGL Fond DELL'ALBA Gianfranco (ARE) - Initial exchange of views 8. Assistants: regulations and duties (T04835) REG0067 + REGL Fond R LEHNE Klaus-Heiner. (PPE) - Exchange of views 9. Procedure followed by the Conference of Presidents in respect of Rules 46, 92 and 94 and the reports on the Statute for Members and Members' assistants 10. The committee's programme of activities in 1997 11. Action to be taken on coordinators' proposals (1) 12. Any other business 13. Date of next meeting (PE/XVIII/OJ/97-04 )
[FOOTNOTES]1.) A coordinators' meeting will be held on Monday 3 February at 5.30 p.m. or at the end of the meeting. END OF DOCUMENT.
